## Executive Summary
Fullstack Software Engineer specializing in TypeScript, modern frontend frameworks (React 19, Next.js App Router), scalable backend architectures (Node.js, Express, NestJS), and advanced database solutions (PostgreSQL, MySQL, pgvector, Redis, Prisma, Drizzle ORM). Proven track record shipping production systems, including an institutional university event and attendance system used by 500+ active members, a multi-role charity donation platform integrating Chapa payments with cryptographic webhook verification, and an enterprise AI customer support platform utilizing BullMQ asynchronous worker queues and pgvector embeddings for token-chunked Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

## Flagship Projects & System Architecture

### 1. AgentDesk: AI Customer Support Platform
- **Status:** In Progress / Active Architecture (61 Automated Passing API Tests)
- **Stack:** Next.js, NestJS, TypeScript, pgvector, Drizzle ORM, BullMQ, Redis, MinIO, Turborepo
- **Architecture Highlights:**
  - Designed and built a pnpm/Turborepo monorepo with strict module boundaries.
  - Implemented HTTP-only JWT cookie authentication with Argon2 hashing and granular per-user document ownership enforcement.
  - Engineered the end-to-end knowledge base ingestion pipeline: PDF/TXT document upload to MinIO S3 object storage, raw text extraction, token-based chunking, and administrative dashboard for previewing, deleting, and re-indexing corpus items.
  - Developed an asynchronous background indexing pipeline using BullMQ and Redis supporting automated retries, deduplication, and a swappable embedding provider (OpenAI API or local mock), persisting vectors in pgvector.
  - Comprehensive test suite covering 61 automated passing API integration tests; currently expanding semantic search and citation-backed RAG conversations.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/DagiH22/agentdesk

### 2. Charity Management System
- **Status:** Final-Year Capstone Project — Deployed
- **Stack:** React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Express, Prisma ORM, MySQL (TiDB Cloud), Zod, Chapa API
- **Architecture Highlights:**
  - Architected a 3-tier role-based access control platform (Admin, Charity, Donor) with HTTP-only cookie JWT security.
  - Integrated the Chapa payment gateway with server-side HMAC webhook signature validation, preventing duplicate payment exploits and automating PDF receipt generation.
  - Implemented charity legal document upload verification (Multer), campaign image processing, Nodemailer transactional notifications, and real-time donation analytics with Recharts.
  - Fully validated request boundaries with Zod schemas; deployed live on Vercel with a managed TiDB Cloud distributed MySQL cluster.
- **Live Deployment:** https://charity-management-system-nu.vercel.app/
- **Repository:** https://github.com/DagiH22/charity-management-system

### 3. Attendance Management System
- **Status:** In Production (Institutional Deployment)
- **Stack:** React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Brevo
- **Architecture Highlights:**
  - Engineered high-concurrency QR-code generation and check-in workflows for university events, serving 500+ active student and faculty members.
  - Implemented secure JWT session authentication, real-time participation analytics dashboards, event lifecycle state machines, and automated Brevo email alerts.
  - Normalized relational PostgreSQL schema using Prisma ORM with ACID guarantees during concurrent badge scans.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/DagiH22/Attendance-System
